description: Locked reference configuration for the M0 numerical baseline. Every value is explicit: no library default may drift between runs. The comparison rules are fixed here so that they are in place before any acceptance result is produced.

input.member_ids: taken from the sample manifest, in manifest order

validity.rank_rule: the numerical rank of the standardized matrix, computed with a singular-value threshold of 1e-10, must be at least 2 so that a two-dimensional projection is non-degenerate
validity.degenerate_subspace_rule: when the rank, the retained-subspace geometry or the member partition cannot be determined, the comparison fails; the cluster count and the projection dimension are never reduced automatically

comparison.label_rule: labels are canonicalized by first member occurrence, so a cluster-number permutation is not a difference
comparison.pca_sign_rule: each component is sign-normalized so that its largest-absolute loading is positive; the matching score column is flipped with it
comparison.cluster_center_rule: cluster centers are compared after the member partition is matched and after the same sign normalization is applied
comparison.partition_rule: the member partition is compared by co-membership, not by cluster number
comparison.subspace_rule: the retained subspace is compared through the projection matrix and the pairwise member distances; a sign flip of the retained subspace is equivalent

execution.process_isolation: each reference run is a separate operating-system process; the recorded pids must be distinct
